gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-chillax: Bellota Text has open, unshaded letterforms that carry real authority when set big and brief. Chillax follows in a loose, spaghetti-like line whose unfinished curves feel easy and relaxed.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-plein: Bellota Text announces itself with open, unshaded curves and a commanding, distinctive presence at the top. And Plein follows in a plain sans with a clear channel leading into each round letter, so it feels clean and reliable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans opens its curves wide, with every vertical and horizontal stroke weighing the same, which gives it an approachable, contemporary feel. Make Bellota Text small and its commanding display character fades.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-synonym: Bellota Text is the commanding one, open and unshaded in every curve. Synonym does the quieter job, laying down a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings, which makes a dependable sans-serif for steady reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-outfit: Commanding and distinctive, Bellota Text opens its curves without any shading, while Outfit bends cable-like strokes that finish well before they close. One shouts a little and the other keeps things clean.
gen-gf-bellota-text-space-grotesk: Open, unshaded and bold in personality. Space Grotesk then carries a longer read as a geometric sans, its counters breathing and its ribbon of constant width never tiring the eye.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-amulya: Bruno Ace draws every line with a ruler, constant in width. That gives the heading a distinctive display punch, while Amulya's generous curve gaps make it the modern workhorse for the text beneath.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-chillax: Bruno Ace sets its ruler-drawn, constant-width letters in a lingering rhythm, one character per beat, and it feels expressive. Chillax then loosens everything up, its spaghetti line rambling easily along.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-plein: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace keeps its counters connected to the outside and its s spine as thick as its terminals. Plein works the other side, a clean sans with a clear channel into each round letter.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-spline-sans: Ruler-straight lines, one character per beat. Spline Sans gives the quality that matters most here: wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so the approachable body sits against the display heading with ease.
